title: Regenerative Potential of Dental Pulp Cells Cultured Under Inflammatory Conditions Using Platelet-Rich Plasma, Injectable Platelet-Rich Fibrin, and Concentrated Platelet-Rich Fibrin: A Comparative Analysis
html: The development of various autologous platelet concentrates (APCs) has garnered recent attention for various applications in tissue regeneration. The aim of this study was to investigate 3 protocols to produce APCs on the biological capacity of human dental pulp cells (hDPCs) cultured under both normal and inflammatory conditions (induced by LPS from E. coli) in vitro.
